name: Bandits
s: The patriarch of a family is imprisoned for con-artistry. In a corner and hoping to release their father, the rest of the family is forced to follow in his steps and scam "bad" people to raise enough money.

paragraphs.text: Ulan İstanbul is a Turkish drama TV series that aired from 23 June 2014 to 23 March 2015 on the Kanal D network. The television finale aired on 9 February 2015, and its last six episodes were streamed on the internet.
